title: Combat polish: dead-code cleanup + post-respawn i-frames + i-frame projectile pass-through
description: Small consolidation/fairness pass before adding the next big feature. Three items: (1) DEAD-CODE CLEANUP (subsumes TASK-009): remove the now-unused suppress_jump_impulse field from scripts/player/player.gd and test/helpers/fake_player.gd, delete the unreachable skip-impulse branch in scripts/fsm/states/jump_state.gd (keep the normal impulse + register_jump path), and drop any obsolete test reference; no remaining references anywhere. (2) POST-RESPAWN I-FRAMES (DD-001 fairness): scripts/player/player.gd respawn() should grant brief spawn-protection by triggering the Invulnerability window so the player can't be instantly re-hit by an in-flight enemy projectile; update the existing test that asserts is_invulnerable() is false after respawn to assert it is TRUE (spawn protection), and keep the rest of the respawn assertions (full HP, position reset). (3) I-FRAME PROJECTILE PASS-THROUGH: scripts/combat/enemy_projectile.gd should NOT consume itself (no damage, no queue_free) when it overlaps a player that is currently invulnerable — it passes through so i-frames truly mean untouchable; add a test asserting an invulnerable player neither takes damage nor consumes the projectile, and a vulnerable player does both. Keep all other behavior and tests intact. Follow the project-context Bash gotcha (NEVER prefix Godot/GUT commands with 'cd ... &&'; absolute --path; run --import if class cache needs it). Verify headless load clean + full GUT suite exits 0.
acceptance_criteria: suppress_jump_impulse is fully removed (player.gd, fake_player.gd, jump_state.gd branch) with no remaining references; the normal jump impulse + register_jump path is preserved.
respawn() grants brief i-frame spawn protection (is_invulnerable() true immediately after respawn), with full HP and position reset still correct; the affected test is updated accordingly.
An enemy projectile overlapping an invulnerable player deals no damage AND is not consumed (passes through); against a vulnerable player it damages and frees as before; both cases are unit-tested.
Full GUT suite passes headless (exit 0) with no regression; project loads with zero parse errors.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Polish done (commit b4f8bf6). Orchestrator verified 121/121 GUT exit 0, clean load, zero suppress_jump_impulse refs in code. Reviewer (fresh) ACCEPT: JumpState.enter() still unconditionally applies impulse + register_jump (double-jump intact); respawn() opens 0.8s spawn-protection i-frames with HP/position reset preserved; enemy projectile routes live signal path through the same should_land_hit/resolve_hit gate (invuln=pass-through no-damage-no-free, vuln=damage+free), lifetime cleanup still frees lingering shots (no immortal projectile). Tests non-vacuous. Only LOW cosmetics. Done.
